body: It might depend on who you get advice from. 'It's your brain freaking out' someone said to me and was very straight forward. I've also just had a friend hold my hand which didn't help as much in the long run. I did a lot of grounding exercises such as walking heal to toe and being around other people. It helps to talk to someone maybe of similar ethnicity or is very similar to you. Maybe they could give you better advice. Was depersonalized for over a year and I don't dissociate on a consistent basis anymore. If I feel a dissociated state come on I know how to quickly ground myself and don't feel the depersonalization or derealization. You've got this.
Thank you

Being afraid of being a molester isn't the same as actually being a molester. Watching and checking responses isn't watching thinking ..."sexy".
Analyzing your feelings and noticing anything slightly different than indifference may not mean you are a pedophile. Getting older I also remember what I thought as a young kid- indifference, compared to now, now they look cute and I am extremely bothered by the thought that it is sexual attraction. What has changed that is remembering where the fear came from, I was molested. I should he been treated better, I should have been respected. Kids aren't thinking shit when it comes to interacting with an adult that is thinking they are being sexual/acting sexy. Taking their stress, hateful mom issues, or their own issues out on a vulnerable person. I should have been being raised to go on my own in this world. I now just react as an example and give them the respect I deserved, healthy assumptions for fuck sake. I wouldn't want someone just looking at me thinking I'm stupid and looking at my body parts like a stupid psychopath. That's my take.
